title: Trump’s new contractor executive order is an affront to Congress’ oversight authority
summary: COMMENTARY | Due to a new executive order, contractors must now choose between an existential risk to their business today and contempt proceedings tomorrow.

title: Intelligence chief Jay Clayton to lead White House cyber office in interim capacity
summary: Clayton would add the temporary assignment to his intelligence and AI duties while Kirsten Davies seeks Senate confirmation as national cyber director.

title: ‘A team without a game plan.’ IRS staff displaced from their jobs aren’t sure what happens next
summary: “DOGE wanted to downsize” the IRS tech workforce and cut about 1,400 IT jobs, an agency executive told staff. Impacted employees are still at the agency, but stuck in a workplace limbo.

title: Judge: VA is “subverting” court order in union case
summary: But a federal judge said Friday that she is unable to modify her now-stayed injunction restoring VA employees’ collective bargaining rights because questions about the scope of her order are at the “heart” of the department’s appeal to circuit court.

title: Judge puts limits on Agriculture secretary sending religious emails to USDA workforce
summary: USDA officials called the ruling an “unprecedented attempt to muzzle” a secretary and said they are considering an appeal.

title: FDA will have to wait for a permanent commissioner as Trump withdraws nominee
summary: Sen. Bill Cassidy, R-La., said the next confirmation will fall to Senate Democrats after the White House pulled Heidi Overton's nomination ahead of a committee vote.

title: Unions call for 3.8% pay raise as part of funding deal
summary: Democrats and groups representing federal workers are bracing for negotiations with the Trump administration, which has signaled it would freeze federal employee pay next year.

title: USDA grapples with security breach as IT staff take multiple systems offline
summary: The department’s Cybersecurity and Privacy Operations Center “uncovered a security incident,” per an email. It’s not clear who carried out the intrusion or if any data was exfiltrated.

title: Your 2027 federal benefits could cost you more. Here's what to check now
summary: A new FSA card, higher Medicare costs and another long-term care insurance freeze make this year's Open Season especially important. Here's what to know before Dec. 14.

title: ‘I’m not here as a plant.’ Trump’s GAO pick vows to oversee administration he helped run
summary: Eric Ueland said he had little discussion with his boss, OMB Director Russ Vought, about his interest in leading the Government Accountability Office.

title: Trump’s CISA nominee denies Capitol was attacked on Jan. 6
summary: Two senators subsequently said they would place holds on the nominee, who also refused to acknowledge Biden’s 2020 electoral victory.

title: ‘Gagged’ immigration judges return to Supreme Court, asserting ‘First Amendment black hole’
summary: The National Association of Immigration Judges said the Supreme Court’s previous decision in the case has led to a precedential split between court regions that requires settling.

title: Fewer Americans think ICE or the CDC is doing a good job, according to new surveys
summary: Most agencies that the Pew Research Center and Gallup conducted surveys about, however, generally received positive ratings.

title: Trump’s GAO pick was a done deal before Congress got a say
summary: A Senate committee aide told Government Executive that Eric Ueland’s nomination bypassed a bipartisan process for Congress to help pick the head of its own watchdog office.

title: Senate grills acting Navy secretary on Iran war costs, extended deployments
summary: Democrats in particular bristled at Hung Cao’s characterization of unsuccessful suicide attempts as “mitigations.”

title: Ueland’s GAO nomination puts Congress’s power of the purse to the test
summary: COMMENTARY | As OMB’s deputy director, Eric Ueland has been part of an administration at odds with the Government Accountability Office over its authority to withhold appropriated funds. Senators should press him on whether he will lead an independent watchdog.

title: Kupor teases department-specific Tech Force tracks
summary: The two-year program has so far onboarded about 500 engineers across various agencies.

title: They left federal service and ran for Congress. Even in defeat, they found a new way to serve
summary: At least two former feds will be members of the House next year.

title: Classified NSA communications network down, people familiar say
summary: There aren’t any immediate signs that the outage on NSA Net is related to a cyberattack, and it may be linked to a series of software upgrades on the network.

title: GAO's independence matters more than ever as a new comptroller general is chosen
summary: COMMENTARY | The FAA's nationwide ground stop exposed the consequences of poor agency management. The watchdog that warned of trouble needs a leader committed to its nonpartisan mission.

title: Trump taps OMB deputy to lead GAO amid rushed selection process
summary: Eric Ueland would serve a 15-year term leading the congressional watchdog that has challenged the Trump administration's spending and workforce actions.

title: OPM's plan to make feds sign NDAs faces new challenge on Capitol Hill
summary: New legislation would bar the Trump administration from using federal funds to finalize or implement the Office of Personnel Management’s proposal to require all federal workers to sign a non-disclosure agreement.

title: Federal tech fellows would get an expedited path to permanent jobs under a new bill
summary: While the Trump administration’s Tech Force initiative assigns young tech employees to agencies for two-year tours, the sponsor of a new House measure wants to “open the door” to longer-term service.

title: Hegseth wants to elevate the civilian special-ops chief. Congress may not let him
summary: The assistant defense secretary for special ops would rise to service-secretary level, if lawmakers allow it.
